name: jumplist
description: Read a jump list: the DestList entries of an automaticDestinations-ms (target path, the host it was on, access count, last access, pinned), and every embedded link structure written out for lnk_parse. Also splits a customDestinations-ms into its link structures.

path.description: A .automaticDestinations-ms or .customDestinations-ms file, or a directory of them

out_dir.description: Write each embedded link structure here, under work/, for lnk_parse to read; a path outside the run directory or under inputs/ is refused

limit.description: Link structures shown inline per file (default 500); every one is read and written to out_dir, and when there are more the whole list is written as JSON Lines and named in all_results
